title: Hold to Fluctuate
description: Tip: You can hold down quantum fields to make them continuously fluctuate without having to click repeatedly, and even move between fields while holding down.

title: Right-Click to Buy
description: Tip: You can right-click (or ctrl + click) most buy buttons in the game to buy 10 levels at once, or hold them to buy as many levels as possible.

title: Energy Upgrades
description: You have a good amount of electrons now, which each generate a certaim amount of energy when they appear. Check the energy tab to see what you can invest it in.

title: Particle Conversion
description: As you don't have access gluons yet, we can't confine Quarks into more complex particles just yet. Nontheless you can already start harnessing their combined energy and funnel it into ever-increasing boosts to your quantum system.
